For the OpsGuru meeting this afternoon, I want this to be clear.

I am looking for the absolute shortest path to integration. Not the full vision. Not every wish and desire. The pragmatic route that gets us live.

Please ask them to frame this as bronze, silver, and gold so we are clear on trade offs at each level. I want to see the staged path, with a realistic bronze version that gets us across the line quickly.

Specifically, I need a feed that:
• Uses stated user preferences
• Blends in relevant breaking news (if we have to handle that ourselves, fine)
• Stays fresh each day

Fresh means the personal feed feels current, dynamic, and consistent. It should never have fewer than around four to seven videos. The deeper nuances of freshness can follow. I want the core logic and behaviour set first.

Please press on what is required technically in stages and how quickly we could realistically launch.
On subsidies, I assume we will not qualify since this is existing work. Please confirm either way and rule it out clearly if not viable.

Keep the discussion focused on practical, phased execution
